The 5.20 mm parameter is the catch throat, not the hex pocket: the hex pocket is 5.90 mm across flats. Test hand insertion and upside-down retention on the coupon before using the knob. Finished assembly is one printed knob plus one captive nut.","params":{"knob_d":{"value":20,"kind":"world","source":"asked"},"knob_h":{"value":8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_d":{"value":12,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"nut_af":{"value":5.5,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"nut_h":{"value":2.4,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"bolt_d":{"value":3,"kind":"hardware","source":"catalog"},"hex_clearance_af":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"bolt_clearance_d":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"floor_h":{"value":2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_root_z":{"value":0.6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_t":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"finger_w":{"value":1.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_gap":{"value":0.7,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"catch_throat_af":{"value":5.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"nut_axial_play":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"catch_land_h":{"value":0.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"catch_ramp_h":{"value":1.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_count":{"value":10,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_r":{"value":2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_center_r":{"value":11.3,"kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"def build(p):
    import math
    a = (p.nut_af+p.hex_clearance_af)/2
    h = p.knob_h
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(h)
    for i in range(int(p.scallop_count)):
        ang = 2*math.pi*i/p.scallop_count
        body = body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').center(p.scallop_center_r*math.cos(ang),p.scallop_center_r*math.sin(ang)).circle(p.scallop_r).extrude(h))
    rr = a/math.cos(math.pi/6)
    pts = [(rr*math.cos(math.radians(30+60*i)),rr*math.sin(math.radians(30+60*i))) for i in range(6)]
    body = body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_h).polyline(pts).close().extrude(h-p.floor_h))
    body = body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clearance_d)/2).extrude(h))
    t,w,g = p.finger_t,p.finger_w,p.slot_gap
    z0 = p.finger_root_z
    def box(x0,x1,y0,y1):
        return cq.Workplane('XY').box(x1-x0,y1-y0,h-z0,centered=(False,False,False)).translate((x0,y0,z0))
    for deg in (0,120,240):
        slots = box(a+t,a+t+g,-w/2-g,w/2+g).union(box(a-g,a+t+g,w/2,w/2+g)).union(box(a-g,a+t+g,-w/2-g,-w/2))
        body = body.cut(slots.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),deg))
        z = p.floor_h+p.nut_h+p.nut_axial_play
        tip = p.catch_throat_af/2
        profile = [(a,z),(tip,z),(tip,z+p.catch_land_h),(a,z+p.catch_land_h+p.catch_ramp_h),(a+t,z+p.catch_land_h+p.catch_ramp_h),(a+t,z)]
        catch = cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(profile).close().extrude(w).translate((0,w/2,0)).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),deg)
        body = body.union(catch)
    return body.clean()
","print_orientation":"Flat bottom at z=0 on bed; pocket up. No supports.","use_orientation":"Nut presses into recessed pocket; bottom shoulder prevents far-side escape. Central bore passes the bolt. Flat bottom is the bearing face in thumb-nut use."},{"id":"fit_coupon","role":"coupon","material":"PLA (high-speed PLA, black)","code":"def build(p):
    import math
    a = (p.nut_af+p.hex_clearance_af)/2
    h = p.knob_h
    body = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.coupon_d/2).extrude(h)
    rr = a/math.cos(math.pi/6)
    pts = [(rr*math.cos(math.radians(30+60*i)),rr*math.sin(math.radians(30+60*i))) for i in range(6)]
    body = body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor_h).polyline(pts).close().extrude(h-p.floor_h))
    body = body.cut(cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clearance_d)/2).extrude(h))
    t,w,g = p.finger_t,p.finger_w,p.slot_gap
    z0 = p.finger_root_z
    def box(x0,x1,y0,y1):
        return cq.Workplane('XY').box(x1-x0,y1-y0,h-z0,centered=(False,False,False)).translate((x0,y0,z0))
    for deg in (0,120,240):
        slots = box(a+t,a+t+g,-w/2-g,w/2+g).union(box(a-g,a+t+g,w/2,w/2+g)).union(box(a-g,a+t+g,-w/2-g,-w/2))
        body = body.cut(slots.rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),deg))
        z = p.floor_h+p.nut_h+p.nut_axial_play
        tip = p.catch_throat_af/2
        profile = [(a,z),(tip,z),(tip,z+p.catch_land_h),(a,z+p.catch_land_h+p.catch_ramp_h),(a+t,z+p.catch_land_h+p.catch_ramp_h),(a+t,z)]
        catch = cq.Workplane('XZ').polyline(profile).close().extrude(w).translate((0,w/2,0)).rotate((0,0,0),(0,0,1),deg)
        body = body.union(catch)
    return body.clean()

Fingers must return inward and retain nut when inverted and gently shaken."}},{"id":"seat","part":"knob","feature":"Recessed hex seat and bottom shoulder","relation":"seats","hardware":"nut","params":["nut_af","nut_h","hex_clearance_af","floor_h","knob_h","nut_axial_play"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Nut must rest flat, entirely below top surface, and not spin freely during gentle bolt threading. Small axial play is intentional."}},{"id":"passage","part":"knob","feature":"Central through bore","relation":"clears","hardware":"test_bolt","clearance_mm":0.25,"params":["bolt_d","bolt_clearance_d"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Thread bolt through nut by fingers until it exits bottom without binding on plastic."}},{"id":"stop","part":"knob","feature":"Bottom shoulder around through bore","relation":"supports","hardware":"nut","params":["floor_h","nut_af","bolt_d","bolt_clearance_d"],"check":{"method":"coupon","ref":"fit_coupon","description":"Firm hand pressure must not push nut through bottom; do not use a hammer or press."}}],"manual":[{"n":"1","text":"Print fit_coupon first in PLA: 0.4 mm nozzle, 0.2 mm layers, 4 walls, 100% infill, no supports. Use variable-width walls if available. Preview continuous 0.8 mm fingers and open relief slots. Cool fully before testing.","parts":["fit_coupon"]},{"n":"2","text":"Align nut flats with hex seat and press evenly with your thumb until nut passes all three catches and rests on shoulder. Do not hammer. Inspect for cracks or permanently bent fingers. Invert and gently shake: nut must stay in. Small axial movement is intentional.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"3","text":"If hand insertion is too stiff, increase catch_throat_af from 5.2 to 5.3 mm and reprint coupon. If nut falls out, decrease to 5.1 mm and retest. If nut binds in the hex pocket itself, increase hex_clearance_af by 0.1 mm and repeat all tests. These changes are not applied to this submission because no fit outcome was available.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut"]},{"n":"4","text":"Thread test_bolt through captured nut by fingers until it emerges from bottom. Check nut does not spin and plastic does not bind. Remove bolt. To reclaim nut, gently push it out from below using the bolt's blunt end, keeping fingers clear; this may damage coupon catches. Alternatively use another ISO 4032 M3 nut for the final knob and repeat fit checks.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut","test_bolt"]},{"n":"5","text":"After coupon passes, print knob with successful parameters and identical slicer settings, pocket up. Cool fully, press nut in by hand and repeat all retention, seating and passage checks. Finished item is one printed knob plus captive nut, without glue or separate retaining parts.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut","test_bolt"]},{"n":"6","text":"Use as a captive-nut hand fastener on an M3 bolt. Start threads gently. Bolt can extend through the nut and out the other face. Flat bottom is bearing face for thumb-nut use. Tighten by hand only, without pliers. Avoid heat, safety-critical loads and repeated nut removal. Replace if cracked or retention fails.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut"]}]}
